candidate.label: First 0.5.0-alpha.1 developer preview; pre-publication technical review

decision.rationale: Separate delegated NF-110 technical readiness decision under the adopted bounded first-alpha profile. Existing B1-B8 technical preparation criteria have factual candidate-bound evidence. This is not beta/full conformance readiness, personally performed/independent review, publication permission or public-install verification; those later authority/observations are explicitly pending in the evidence index and runbook.

documentation.summary: Synchronized alpha installation, support, limitations and B1-B8 review material; review file hashes verified separately.

schemas.summary: 18 exact embedded schema files/17 kinds, local closure/indexes verified in the actual archives; no new manifest dialect.

evidence.description: 54 actual package checks with schema/index/ref consumer verification

examples.summary: Maintained source examples and eight installed project sets passed; source and native evidence remain separately scoped.

evidence.description: 68 local source checks and successful exact-source CI

validation.summary: Candidate CLI/library source regression, installed security/packaging and three native lifecycle records match selected bytes; semantic/Core/extension/runtime layers remain not-run.

evidence.description: Native current and genuine predecessor lifecycle/commands/API/OS controls

rfc-governance.summary: Adopted NF-104 first-alpha profile and scoped Accepted RFC-0025 under RFC-0024/ownership; delegated technical decision, no personal/independent or publication approval inferred.

compatibility-migrations.summary: Independent version domains, no NF-CLI claim, old-output migration, exact native prerequisites and genuine rollback documented and checked.

security-limitations.summary: Selected actual runtime/build/tool graphs have dated full inputs; no unresolved matches, retained affected tooling and untested native/general isolation/publisher boundaries explicit.

evidence.description: Exact candidate security/advisory/limits and original records
Current reporting and bounded owner guidance

release-evidence.summary: One immutable staged candidate, exact source/digests and all three native outcomes; prepared asset/runbook review only. Public release authority/download observations remain required later.

evidence.description: Original exact native evidence and common archive inputs

limitations: No separate release/promotion/publication authority has been granted; no tag/release/public download verification is claimed.
Unsigned developer external-Node route only; exact Node 26.13.0/npm 11.20.0 and three recorded targets, with no general filesystem/process sandbox.
No NF-CLI/full semantic/Core/extension/runtime conformance claim; init and execution unsupported.
Root/npm tool advisory instances retain explicit bounded dispositions; current absence of delivered matches is not a permanent vulnerability guarantee.
No independent publisher signatures, Developer ID/notarization, Authenticode or complete native/CPE/OS advisory coverage.
Best-effort single-maintainer support without fixed SLA, lifetime, backup, on-call or independent assurance.
Original historical alpha/beta preparation not-ready records and failed/rejected evaluation results remain unchanged.
